name: Rooted Distance-Cube Polynomial
definition: For a rooted graph $(G,u)$, let $c_{k,d}(G,u)$ count induced $k$-cubes whose minimum distance from $u$ is $d$, and put $D_{G,u}(x,y)=\sum_{k,d\ge0}c_{k,d}(G,u)x^ky^d$.
codomain: Bivariate polynomials with nonnegative integer coefficients
comments: It specializes to $C(G,x)$ at $y=1$ and to the rooted distance polynomial at $x=0$.
